small_guidance:
- Add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_W (e.g. 64) and num_warps=8/16 so each program covers more spatial outputs and amortizes the 8x (ddp,dhp,dwp) static-range unroll over more lanes.
- Try swapping the loop order so `ic` is the outer accumulation loop and (kd,kh,kw) are inner static_range — current order reloads the same weight tile across IC, restructuring can let the compiler keep weights in registers and reduce register pressure.
- Precompute and pass `(2*PAD - kd) % STRIDE`–style constants and hoist `(num % STRIDE)==0` checks out of the inner ic loop (they don't depend on ic), and pass STRIDE/PAD as constexpr (already done) — also add num_stages=4 variants for the larger-BLOCK_W configs.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an im2col-style GEMM: gather the transposed-conv contributions for one (n, dp, hp, w-tile) into a [OC, BLOCK_W] accumulator using `tl.dot` on tiles of shape [OC, IC] × [IC, BLOCK_W], rather than the current scalar `wv[:,None]*xv[None,:]` outer product per (ic,kd,kh,kw). With OC=16, pad OC to 16 and use tensor cores via `tl.dot`.
- Fuse the 2×2×2 maxpool more tightly: instead of recomputing 8 independent accumulators per output, compute the conv output once for a 2×(BLOCK_W*2) tile in registers and reduce within the kernel — this halves redundant weight loads and the input-index arithmetic.
- Consider a scatter-add design (one program per input voxel, scatter OC×KD×KH×KW contributions) only if gather pressure dominates; otherwise keep gather but switch to channels-last weight layout `(OC, IC, KD, KH, KW)` with OC contiguous so the `tl.load(w_ptr + ...)` over offs_oc is a single contiguous vector load instead of a strided gather of stride KDHKW.
